description: Source code for Electron integration within Playwright, including classes for Electron application management and launching Electron instances, with handling of process communication, console messages, and debugging.

classes.name: ElectronApplication
classes.description: Represents an Electron application instance, manages communication, console events, and application lifecycle.

classes.name: Electron
classes.description: Main class to launch Electron applications, handling process setup, debugging, and connection establishment.

methods.name: ElectronApplication._onConsoleAPI
methods.description: Handles console API calls from Electron's runtime, emitting console messages.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Electron application by enabling runtime and executing startup script.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.process
methods.description: Returns the child process of the Electron app.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.context
methods.description: Returns the browser context associated with the Electron app.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.browserWindow
methods.description: Returns a handle to the BrowserWindow for a given page.

methods.name: Electron.launch
methods.description: Launches a new Electron application with specified options, establishing debugging and communication channels.
